query:
UPDATE products SET description = 'The declaration. No hedging, no fine print. Just a tee that says exactly what it is. Premium cotton, clean lines, and a print that doesn''t apologize.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
200 GSM midweight jersey
Regular fit
Ribbed crew neck
Double-stitched hems

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
Screen print — built to last' WHERE id = 60001;
UPDATE products SET description = 'The peace offering. Because fake doesn''t mean hostile — it means honest about the performance. Soft hand feel, relaxed cut, and a message worth repeating.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
200 GSM midweight jersey
Relaxed fit
Ribbed crew neck
Double-stitched hems

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
Screen print — built to last' WHERE id = 60002;
UPDATE products SET description = 'The mantra. Three words that cover everything from Monday meetings to Saturday nights. Lightweight enough for layering, heavy enough to stand alone.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
200 GSM midweight jersey
Regular fit
Ribbed crew neck
Double-stitched hems

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
Screen print — built to last' WHERE id = 60003;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Downtime', description = 'Built for the hours you don''t have to explain yourself. French terry with a brushed interior that feels like you''re still in bed. Tapered leg, elastic waist, deep pockets. The pants you reach for first.

MATERIALS:
80% cotton, 20% polyester
320 GSM french terry
Relaxed tapered fit
Elastic waistband with internal drawcord
Deep side pockets
Ribbed ankle cuffs

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Do not iron directly on fabric' WHERE id = 80001;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Forecast', description = 'Red and white colorblock that turns weather into a statement. Water-resistant shell, mesh lining, and a zip that doesn''t jam when you need it most. Packs into its own pocket.

MATERIALS:
100% nylon ripstop shell
Mesh polyester lining
Water-resistant DWR coating
Elastic cuffs and hem
Full-zip front with storm flap
Packable into front pocket

CARE:
Machine wash cold, gentle cycle
Hang dry recommended
Do not bleach
Do not iron
Do not dry clean' WHERE id = 80002;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Introduction', description = 'The shirt you wear when you want to look put together without looking like you''re trying. Pique cotton, ribbed collar, embroidered Fake script on the chest. Pairs with everything from chinos to cargo shorts.

MATERIALS:
100% pique cotton
220 GSM
Classic fit
Three-button placket
Ribbed collar and sleeve bands
Embroidered chest logo
Side vents

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat if needed' WHERE id = 80003;
